blogs.title: Stop Paying Per-Category Prediction: How LLMs Became Our 'Smartest' Data Analysts
blogs.description: This post demystifies the shift from expensive, per-sample LLM inference for tabular data to the 'FeatLLM' approach. We explain how acting as a 'feature engineer,' an LLM can distill complex decision rules once during training, allowing simple, instant linear models to handle millions of predictions without calling the API again. Learn why this method saves money and time while boosting accuracy in low-data scenarios.

blogs.title: Less is More: Leveraging LLMs to Solve Tabular Problems with Just a Few Examples
blogs.description: Few-shot learning is notoriously difficult with structured data. In this article, we explore how FeatLLM combines the common-sense reasoning of Large Language Models with classical machine learning to achieve high performance using only 4 labeled examples. We break down the 'two-step reasoning' strategy where LLMs first identify causal priorities and then extract specific prediction rules, effectively teaching computers to recognize patterns in tiny datasets.

blogs.title: Cracking the Context Window Wall: How Bagging and Ensembles Save Mayhem with Huge Datasets
blogs.description: Running a 100-column dataset through an LLM prompt often results in timeouts or errors due to token limits. Discover how FeatLLM turns this limitation into a strength by implementing a 'bagging' ensemble method. We'll walk through how generating multiple sets of simplified features across smaller data batches allows the model to tackle massive, complex tables that would otherwise break standard prompt-based approaches.
